units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 1:4">Peah I, 4</cite> <he>ומכניסו לק׳</he> and what one brings in for storage (not for immediate use); Y. ib. I, 16ᶜ top. Ib. bot. <he>דבר שאינו לק׳</he> a thing which is not intended or fit for storage.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:1:5">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᵃ</cite> top; Bab.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 74b:5">Ab. Zar. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>זה מכניסו לק׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בק׳</he>) the one (vessel) one brings in for storage (to leave the wine there for some time) &c., v. <cite ref="M00478"><he>מוּכְנָס</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 2:3:4">Y. Kil. II, 27ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מקומו … שאינו רוצה בקִיּוּמוֹ</he> the place where it grows is evidence that he does not want its preservation (to cultivate it).

<cite ref="Yoma 45a:8">Yoma 45ᵃ</cite> <he>אחת של ק׳ האש</he> one pile for the purpose of keeping up the fire; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:23">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:23">II</cite>), 23 <he>אחת לק׳ האש</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>לקיים</he>, corr. acc.); Y. ib. IV, 41ᵈ bot. <he>מערכת קִיּוּמֵי אש</he> (pl.); a. e.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:1:9">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>אילין פליגין על דרב ולית להון ק׳</he> (not <he>דבר</he>) these opinions conflict with Rab’s, and have no foundation; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:6:3">Y. Ḥag. II, end, 78ᶜ</cite>

<cite ref="Gittin 3a:4">Gitt. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ שטרות</he> the identification of signatures on documents (certification before court). Y. ib. II, beg. 44ᵃ <he>כלום קִיּוּמוֹ של גט וכ׳</he> is there any other way of authenticating a letter of divorce than through the declarations of its signers? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:11">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> (ref. to Esau’s declaration, <cite ref="Genesis 33:9">Gen. XXXIII, 9</cite>) <he>אין ק׳ חגט וכ׳</he> there is no better attestation to the legality of a document than through its signers.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21a:2">B. Mets. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>עדי ק׳</he> signature of witnesses to the authentication before court.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:6">B. Bath. X, 6</cite> <he>ועושין לו ק׳ איש וכ׳</he> and the court makes out a certificate, This man’s document was effaced &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 11:8">Tosef. ib. XI, 8</cite>, sq.; Y. ib. X, 17ᶜ bot.; a. e.
